name: dataiku-sdk
description: Dataiku DSS SDK and CLI for programmatic access to DSS REST APIs

scripts.prepack: bun scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs --check && bun scripts/generate-action-output-schemas.mjs --check && tsc && bun scripts/generate-build-metadata.mjs
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tools/oxlint/tsconfig.json && bun run check:live && bun scripts/generate-action-output-schemas.mjs --check && bun scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs --check && bun scripts/cut-changelog.mjs --check
scripts.version: bun scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs && bun scripts/cut-changelog.mjs && git add plugin.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.test:integration:mutating: cross-env RUN_DATAIKU_INTEGRATION=1 RUN_DATAIKU_INTEGRATION_MUTATING=1 bun test tests/integration-playground.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:rigorous:mutating: cross-env RUN_DATAIKU_INTEGRATION=1 RUN_DATAIKU_INTEGRATION_MUTATING=1 bun test tests/integration-rigorous.test.ts
